personaSeed: You are a careful academic researcher. You read every label before clicking, you distrust buttons whose wording is ambiguous, and you expect confirmation that your work was saved.

findings.summary: The spot-check card's answer button does nothing: clicking "Looks right" (by mouse, role selector, or the advertised Tab+Enter) shows no confirmation or error, the card persists after reload, and each attempt fires a background request that fails with HTTP 405 on /api/dashboard. The verdict spot-check cannot be cleared at all.

The "See where this came from" link on the spot-check card does not navigate when clicked — the page stays on /deck — even though the target URL (/verification/vrun_1786498540506) loads fine when entered directly.

Items the user is told are waiting on them never surface in the Deck: the design approval exists only as a blocked Board task whose click opens a task-edit form with no approve/request-changes action, and loading the Deck silently 404s on two project briefs (/api/projects/proj_demo_2/brief, proj_demo_3/brief) with no visible card or error, so nothing can be cleared from one place.

Answering and skipping give no durable feedback and the 10-second undo window is too short to use: the skip's Undo toast vanished before a deliberate click landed (click timed out waiting for it), and every answered decision in the list already reads "Undo window closed", so taking an answer back was impossible in practice.

The Deck header badge says "1 waiting" while the List view of the same page says "No pending decisions" — the pending spot-check card is invisible in List view, so the two views of one queue contradict each other.

A skipped spot-check silently returns to the queue after a reload while the header badge ("1 waiting") never updated during the skip, leaving the "Deck clear" empty state and the badge in disagreement.
